title: Probe clips on a contact sheet before posing (names don't predict silhouettes)
summary: Render every candidate clip at 6 times from the shot's side in ONE render and pick the nearest silhouette; then hinge/lean/IK. Clip names don't predict silhouettes.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

doc.when: Before choosing a clip for any reference or story pose.
doc.avoid: Choosing by clip name ('Digging' barely bends; 'Push' is crouched with the arms overhead).
gotchas: Probe from the shot's own side (pry): a bend facing away hides.

problem.symptom: A pose looks nothing like what the clip name promised; passes are spent swapping clips.
problem.cause: Retargeted mocap clips are named by action, not by silhouette.
problem.fix: One probe render of all candidates, then choose.
problem.detect: More than one pass spent trying clips.
